insight_text: Overall baseline placement rate is 63.33% across 1,500 students.
Civil Engineering leads branch placement at 68.57%, while Mechanical Engineering is lowest at 55.83%.
SQL shows highest placement spread (+9.17 pp), followed by Python (+6.94 pp) and Cloud (+6.04 pp).
Product companies offer highest average compensation (16.26 LPA mean, 16.03 LPA median).
